english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a person, action, or thing is unwelcome.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not liked or lacks popularity.

examples.english: This salesperson is unwanted in front of the family.
examples.traditional: 呢個推銷員喺屋企人面前唔受歡迎。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4 hai2 uk1 kei2 jan4 min6 cin4 m4 sau6 fun1 jing4

examples.english: Although this movie is well made, it is unpopular locally.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲雖然拍得好，但喺本地唔受歡迎。
examples.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 seoi1 jin4 paak3 dak1 hou2 daan6 hai2 bun2 dei6 m4 sau6 fun1 jing4
